source: Original figures extracted from the supplied 313-page research notebook export; archived outputs, not rerun for this documentation update.

graphs.title: Initial AX versus AX+BF
graphs.caption: Sensing adds overhead; AX-only 57.1786 Mbps remains above the tested BF intervals.

graphs.title: Sensing interval optimization
graphs.caption: Longer intervals reduce sensing overhead; throughput alone does not establish sensing quality.

graphs.title: Sensing availability
graphs.caption: Report rate falls as sensing interval increases. The 3 reports/s line is an illustrative target.

graphs.title: Matched MCS and payload
graphs.caption: Compare matching MCS/payload settings; mixed AX+BF does not beat its matched AX baseline.

graphs.title: Guard interval and contention window
graphs.caption: Tuning helps both modes. Improved AX+BF does not establish superiority over equally tuned AX.

graphs.title: Spatial reuse ON/OFF
graphs.caption: OBSS-PD is an existing Wi-Fi 6 feature. Two-BSS total throughput depends on separation and geometry.

graphs.title: Spatial reuse gain
graphs.caption: Up to 84.288% in these layouts; not a new standard feature invented by this project.

graphs.title: SARA V1
graphs.caption: Standard, best fixed and SARA V1 each report 12.7624 Mbps.

graphs.title: SARA V2
graphs.caption: The displayed challenging-layout tests do not show extra gain over standard/best tested settings.

graphs.title: SAGE V1/V2 link model
graphs.caption: Not ns-3. V1/V2 can underperform ACK adaptation; interference is a different result.

graphs.title: SAGE V3 stable channel
graphs.caption: AX-only is unchanged at 103.481 Mbps; mixed changes from 103.0558 to 103.0520 Mbps.

graphs.title: SAGE V3 fading throughput
graphs.caption: IdealWifiManager baseline; seeds 1101-1112. Not hardware, and event traces may differ between controllers.

graphs.title: SAGE V3 relative gains
graphs.caption: Largest reported AX-only severe-fading gain: 51.864%, displayed as 51.86%. Relative gain is not percentage points.

graphs.title: BF successful reports
graphs.caption: Rayleigh: 2.958 to 2.667 reports/s; severe: 2.492 to 1.933. Communication gain is not sensing reliability gain.

graphs.title: BF failed reports
graphs.caption: Mean failures per 10-second run rise: Rayleigh 2.250 to 4.667; severe 5.500 to 10.833.

graphs.title: SmartCSI accuracy
graphs.caption: 73.33%, 86.67%, 93.33%. Base scores are date-held-out; the final rule was explored using available results. Independent validation needed.

graphs.title: SmartCSI false alarms
graphs.caption: False alarms 4 to 2 to 1. This is not network throughput or verified live detection.

graphs.title: GA feature reduction
graphs.caption: 1024 to 13 = 98.7305% reduction. Fold masks are needed for full reproduction; not all app runs use this mask.

graphs.title: Final archived dashboard
graphs.caption: Different metrics and protocols remain separate. BF report reliability declined despite communication gains.
